response.text: Findings so far: two unbalanced journals, one negative invoice amount, and the dictionary's account-type list is incomplete (no REVENUE/EQUITY), though no account uses them. Let me inspect the anomalies and the journal sign/date conventions.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbalanced' k, "JRNL_NO"::text a, (SUM("DR_AMT")-SUM("CR_AMT"))::text b, COUNT(*)::text c FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT") UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv', "INV_ID"::text, "INV_AMT"::text, "STAT_CD"::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_jrnl_sample', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."SRC_CD"||' '||h."SRC_REF", COALESCE(h."MEMO",'') FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='AP' AND h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT MIN("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP') UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_jrnl_sample', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."SRC_CD"||' '||h."SRC_REF", COALESCE(h."MEMO",'') FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT MIN("JRNL_NO") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL') UNION ALL SELECT 'date_fmt', MIN("INV_DT")::text, MAX("INV_DT")::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL SELECT 'ref_jrnl', COUNT(*)::text, COUNT("REF_JRNL_NO")::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH";

SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", h."SRC_CD", h."POST_FLG", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT" FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" WHERE l."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT")) ORDER BY 1,2;
